nodes.text: @WednesdayWeird1 @alyxamutt I completely agree that cons should have a refund policy for illnesses. Maybe not colds but things like the flu, covid or HMPV should certainly be refundable. Otherwise, people don't have much of an incentive to stay home if they won't get their money back.
